posts.text:
Seismic!

“current deep learning methods are weak and inefficient, and need not more tweaks, but fundamentally new ideas and a thorough reworking before they can provide a solid foundation for achieving the more ambitious goals of AI” — incredible to see @RichardSutton so forcefully affirm what I have been saying since 2018, in “Deep learning: A Critical Appraisal” an arXiv paper that @ylecun once alleged was “mostly wrong”.
